This '''clone''' was a [[Clone cadet/Legends|cadet]] and participated in the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Biography==
During the assault on [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], this [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadet]] and four other members of his squad got separated from the main group of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]. During the battle, the cadets stumbled across [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Echo/Legends|Echo]], [[Fives/Legends|Fives]] and [[99/Legends|99]], who decide to bring them to safety inside the barracks. There they are joined by [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|clone marshal commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]. Although their chances did not look good, Fives and Echo succeed in raising the morale of the young cadets, and 99 showed them the way to a nearby armory, where they re-equip themselves. Soon after, a platoon of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] attacked the barracks, but the clones eventually managed to defeat them by having all of the cadets, including this one, hide inside the sleeping quarters and jump out and shoot the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with their [[DC-15S/Legends|blaster carbines]] at the right time.<ref name="ARC Troopers" />
